purpose.summary: Observe reconstructible native-asset family diagnostics in confirmed blocks without assigning token validity or consensus authority.
scope: Reuse the inherited SLP/ALP parser and colorer to count, once per confirmed transaction, recognized SLP-family and ALP-family sections.
Count parser and coloring failures as diagnostics and count every output whose serialized locking script starts with 0xef as a CashTokens prefix candidate.
Keep only reversible aggregate counts in the existing volatile 288-block projection and rebuild them from public active-chain block inputs.
Falsify exact connect, eviction, LIFO rollback, reconsider, restart, full reindex, chainstate reindex, pruning, and rebuild-required behavior.
Preserve compile-time default OFF, runtime default OFF, explicit local-regtest-only opt-in, and observe/index-only operation.
exclusions: No consensus, validation, chain-selection, activation, chain-parameter, testnet, mainnet, P2P, RPC, wallet, or user-interface rule changes.
No token validity, ancestry, conservation, prevout, spent-state, balance, UTXO, or strict CashTokens decoding claim.
No per-transaction record, transaction body, token identifier, persistence, database, file format, API, socket, service, or thread.
No local binary, build cache, raw output, absolute host path, parent environment, operator material, private history, or unrelated product material enters this change.

files.test_reachability: Defines the exact observation, reconstructed-data, non-authoritative token-state, and no-activation boundaries and documents the new canary.

files.production_reachability: Links the observer to the already-public local bitcoinsuite-slp crate only when the observer is compiled.
files.test_reachability: Makes the inherited parser/colorer available to observer units and explicit local-regtest callbacks.

files.production_reachability: Compiled only in the optional observer component; classifies accepted block bytes after node validation and returns no validation decision.
files.test_reachability: Adds checked reversible family, diagnostic, and prefix-candidate aggregates plus positive, malformed, coloring-failure, eviction, rollback, and fail-closed units.

files.production_reachability: Extends the private observer ABI and logs only; callback remains post-validation, void, and local-regtest opt-in.
files.test_reachability: Exposes exact block and projection counters to the public functional canaries.
Mines real accepted regtest blocks with SLP, ALP, parsed-but-color-failed ALP, malformed SLP, and 0xef prefix-candidate scripts, then checks rollback, reconsider, restart, and full reindex.
Extends the shared log oracle and verifies zero native-asset aggregates across ordinary restart, reindex, chainstate reindex, and deep-reorg scenarios.
Verifies the expanded zero-valued aggregate schema while reconstructing the exact physically-pruned active suffix.

commands: Build with both Chronik options OFF and run mining_basic.py on a fresh isolated regtest datadir.
expected_results: No Chronik link edge enters bitcoind and inherited legacy mining passes unchanged.

commands: Build with BUILD_CHRONIK_OBSERVER=ON, omit runtime opt-in, and run mining_basic.py.
expected_results: The library is linked but no observer starts, no Chronik path or socket exists, and inherited legacy mining passes.

commands: Run feature_chronik_block_observer.py, feature_chronik_asset_observer.py, and feature_chronik_pruned_observer.py with --hermetic-child-env on separate fresh datadirs.
expected_results: All bounded reconstruction scenarios and exact non-authoritative native-asset aggregate observations pass.

scenarios.command: Run disabled and explicit local-regtest observer boundaries, then mine the dedicated accepted native-asset marker blocks.
expected_results: Disabled execution is inert; explicit opt-in observes exact SLP, ALP, parse-failure, coloring-failure, and 0xef prefix-candidate counts; non-regtest profiles reject the flag; no Chronik path or socket exists.
failure_conditions: Any disabled activity, enabled non-regtest launch, counter mismatch, Chronik path/socket, validation decision, token-validity claim, or activation claim fails the scenario.

scenarios.command: Restart a fresh process after bounded observation, including the dedicated non-zero asset aggregate chain.
expected_results: Startup reconstructs the exact readable suffix and adopts the exact family, diagnostic, and prefix-candidate totals without minting live events.
failure_conditions: Partial adoption, wrong suffix or totals, stale state, or growth beyond 288 fails the scenario.

scenarios.command: Run a fresh full -reindex process on both the inherited 288-block canary and the dedicated marker-block chain.
expected_results: Ordered callbacks rebuild the exact bounded projection and the marker chain ends with exact non-zero asset aggregates.
failure_conditions: Missing, duplicated, reordered, rejected, or misclassified callbacks, prior-state reuse, wrong totals, or bound failure fails the scenario.

scenarios.command: Run the inherited fresh -reindex-chainstate=1 process at height 288.
expected_results: The exact active chain is replayed, the tip and UTXO-set hash remain unchanged, and all new aggregates remain zero for ordinary blocks.
failure_conditions: Non-empty bootstrap masking replay, block-file reindex, changed chain state, callback divergence, rejection, or non-zero asset aggregate fails the scenario.

scenarios.command: Restart explicit observer opt-in on the inherited physically-pruned height-1001 datadir.
expected_results: The exact readable heights 714 through 1001 rebuild with 288 blocks and transactions and zero asset aggregates; height 1002 keeps the bound.
failure_conditions: Missing physical pruning, unreadable retained bodies, wrong suffix, event minting, non-zero asset aggregates, or bound growth fails the scenario.

scenarios.command: Run the inherited 288-deep LIFO disconnect, rejected continuation, reconsider, and restart recovery.
expected_results: Every aggregate rolls back with its retained block, the observer enters rebuild-required below its anchor, rejects later events without mutation, and restart reconstructs the active suffix.
failure_conditions: Mutation after rebuild-required, non-LIFO acceptance, counter underflow, silent continuation, node consensus influence, or restart failure fails the scenario.

platforms: Ubuntu 22.04 ARM64 public verification after technical acceptance

limitations: Family counts identify recognized transaction envelopes, not valid token transfers; parsed-but-color-failed ALP still identifies its observed family and is separately diagnosed.
A 0xef first script byte is only a CashTokens prefix candidate, including malformed candidates; no CashTokens payload is decoded.
Only volatile aggregate counts for the readable 288-block suffix are retained; no per-transaction record, historical full-chain index, persistence, or query interface exists.
The observer does not load prevouts or prove token ancestry, conservation, balances, UTXO state, or spend validity.
The dedicated marker blocks use zero-value regtest coinbases to remain valid under the unchanged Ergon consensus; they do not prove economic token behavior.
Local tests are contradiction checks only; no result is public reproduction evidence at record-review time.
counterevidence: No public build or functional execution of the exact candidate exists at record-review time.
Successful parser/colorer observation does not make SLP, ALP, or CashTokens native, valid, authoritative, or active in Ergon consensus.
Restart and reindex reconstruction from block inputs do not demonstrate durable storage, crash recovery, mempool state, historical queries, or API compatibility.
The unchanged default path remains authoritative: Chronik is compiled out or runtime disabled unless explicitly enabled on local regtest.
